engineering_posture.objective: Provide stable local planning contracts and compatibility behavior without production operations that this plugin does not need.
allowed_capabilities: composition-first reuse of installed mature skills with verified dependencies and persistence
deterministic CLI and MCP assessment with visible blocking reasons
explicit user-approved promotion with design re-entry
four intent profiles with profile-specific definitions of done
hash-bound posture references across architecture, design, map, handoff, and compact boundaries
inline hash-bound ApprovalBrief for every human gate
legacy read compatibility and explicit v2.1 migration
profile fixtures, integration tests, and host portability checks
project and module defaults plus lightweight experimental zones
scope provenance and observable behavior budgets for executable work
excluded_capabilities: duplicating mature provider workflow logic without a documented composition blocker
numeric maturity scoring or an automatic maturity ladder
remote policy services or organization-wide governance
telemetry, high availability, deployment automation, and production release operations
engineering_posture.promotion_policy: Evidence may propose promotion, but explicit user approval must create a separate change and re-enter design.

posture_evidence.summary: The plugin exposes a documented, versioned local CLI/MCP contract for posture-aware maps, design gates, migration, and completion.
Legacy reads, exact recovery, provider composition outcomes, host adapters, and repository-relative packaging have dedicated compatibility coverage.
Profile-specific completion, promotion, compact recovery, inline approval, CLI/MCP parity, and skill composition are exercised end to end.

requirements.statement: Expose a fixed, validated N-000 workflow receipt for every map so users can verify the selected route, plugin binding, artifact state, and next action in the terminal.
Model spike, experiment, reusable_internal, and production as intent profiles rather than a quality ladder.
Carry a hash-bound posture through project defaults, maps, nodes, designs, handoffs, and compact-safe execution context.
Admit executable work only when it traces to approved intent/design/contracts, observed failure, or a mandatory safety floor.
Bind implementation to approved observable behavior and the minimum code needed to satisfy it.
Require hypothesis, measurement validity, reproducibility, and fail-loud behavior without speculative production capabilities.
Make posture promotion an explicit user-approved change that re-enters design and architecture synchronization.
Preserve readable legacy artifacts and require explicit migration before new posture claims are authoritative.
Render every human gate as a bounded inline ApprovalBrief in the active conversation; artifact paths are optional audit references only.
Prefer installed mature skills through verified composition contracts; use thin adapters for envelope mismatch and reimplement only with evidence and approved provenance.
